assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production-authored anime pixel gameplay full-body action sheet. Image 1 is the exact existing Survivor throwing identity, pose and four-direction order reference; image 2 is the standing identity reference. Preserve short messy chestnut hair, orange scarf, navy jacket, olive trousers with brown knees, brown boots, tan backpack; identical adult action-anime pixel proportions, coarse pixel clusters, dark outline. Create ONE genuinely transparent rectangular sprite sheet with EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS; generous empty transparent gutters separate every figure. Rows top to bottom NORTH/back, EAST/right, SOUTH/front, WEST/left. Each column is an aligned complete full-body frame; all bodies same scale, feet baseline and center within cell. Character native target about48 pixels tall in96x64 canvas. Full complete bodies, no cut limbs. No weapons or grenades baked anywhere; grenade is a separately rendered6px item, so author anatomically credible hands to surround that item. No shadows or particles, text, borders, colored backdrops. Columns left to right: 1 HOLD: right/anatomical throwing hand cups grenade space near chest, left hand relaxed nearby; 2 PRIME: left fingers pull imaginary ring away from right holding fist, clear separation and believable pin-pull; 3 WINDUP: throwing right hand raised back behind shoulder holding item space, left arm balances, mild torso turn, planted boots; 4 RELEASE: right arm extended toward the ROW'S facing direction, OPEN fingers and palm at unmistakable release contact, left arm balances, no fist at release; 5 FOLLOW THROUGH: right open hand follows down/forward, slight torso turn toward target; 6 RECOVERY: empty hands return beside torso, stance settles. Throwing arm must be anatomical right in all four rows, do NOT mirror a left-hand throw. North row clearly shows backpack and rear hair; South row face/scarf; East and West true profiles. Keep feet approximately planted across this stationary bank; do not imitate a punch. This is authored animation input, not a storyboard. Precise6x4 grid, uniform transparent margin; no extraneous figure. Pixel art with true transparent alpha.
assets.note: Selected sixteen upper poses; North six and West Prime/Windup replaced by selected authored sources. Generated stationary lower poses reused as one standing basis per direction.
